Description: Establish the project infrastructure, database schemas, and core access control.
Set up Git repository, Node.js/Express backend, React/Tailwind frontend, and configure Docker.
Design and provision the MySQL database. Create base tables: Users, Vehicles, Drivers, Depots, Roles. Implement Soft Deletes and Audit Logs.
As a System Administrator, I want to create role-based accounts so that users only see data relevant to their role.
Build the CRUD interfaces for the system's foundational entities.
As an Admin, I want to register new vehicles and depots, so that the fleet database stays current. Includes document upload and tracking.
As a Depot Administrator, I want to record daily driver attendance digitally, so that I don't need a paper sign-in sheet.
As a Maintenance Technician, I want to log completed repairs and parts consumed, so that the vehicle's health score updates.
Enable real-time dispatching, route tracking, and field reporting.
As a Dispatcher, I want to see each driver's current duty status before assigning a trip, to avoid overlapping assignments.
As a Driver, I want to submit a DVIR or incident report from my phone, even offline, so I don't have to wait until I return to the depot.
As a Fuel/Finance Clerk, I want fuel entries automatically reconciled against mileage, so I don't have to calculate consumption by hand.
Bring the system to life with live maps, automated alerts, and predictive analytics.
As a Dispatcher, I want to see a live map of active vehicles using HTML5 Geolocation, so I can respond quickly to delays.
As a Maintenance Technician, I want to see which vehicles are flagged and receive automated alerts for maintenance due.
As a Fleet Owner, I want a single dashboard showing utilization, downtime, and cost trends across the whole fleet.
As a Fleet Manager, I want the system to predict vehicle failure risk using a trained AI model based on historical telemetry.
Ensure the system is robust, secure, and ready for production.
Optimize queries to load dashboard in <3 seconds. Stress test Socket.io with 500 concurrent connections.
Audit RBAC on all API endpoints. Test conflict resolution (last-write-wins).
Run end-to-end workflows (Fault -> Tech -> Repair -> Dispatch) and finalize the User Guide.
